title: Regulation of lipolysis and leptin biosynthesis in rodent adipose tissue by growth hormone.
text_summary: 本研究通过在原代培养物中培养 24 小时的大鼠和小鼠的培养脂肪组织，检测生长激素 (GH) 对脂肪分解和瘦素释放的影响。在 25 nmol/L 地塞米松存在下，发现 GH 刺激大鼠脂肪组织中的瘦素释放，并且伴随着瘦素 mRNA 含量增加 28%。然而，在胰岛素加三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）存在的情况下，GH 对脂肪分解的刺激被消除，并且 GH 增加了瘦素的释放。这些结果表明，在不刺激脂肪分解的情况下，GH 可以刺激小鼠和大鼠脂肪组织释放瘦素。相反，在 GH 刺激脂肪分解的条件下，对瘦素释放没有影响。

Regulation of Lipolysis and Leptin Biosynthesis in Rodent Adipose Tissue by
                           Growth Hormone

                               John N. Fain and Suleiman W. Bahouth

The present study examined the effects of growth hormone (GH} on lipolysis and leptin release by cultured adipose tissue from
rats and mice incubated for 24 hours in primary culture. A stimulation of leptin release by GH in rat adipose tissue was found in
the presence of 25 nmol/L dexamethasone, and this was accompanied by a 28% increase in leptin mRNA content. GH
stimulated lipolysis in rat adipose tissue in the presence of 0.1 nmol/L CL 316,243. In contrast, basal lipolysis in mouse adipose
tissue was stimulated by GH, but this was not accompanied by an increase in leptin release. However, in the presence of insulin
plus triiodothyronine  (T3), the stimulation of lipolysis by GH was abolished and GH increased leptin release. These results
indicate that GH can stimulate leptin release by both mouse and rat adipose tissue in the absence of a stimulation of lipolysis.
In contrast, under conditions in which lipolysis is stimulated by GH, there is no effect on leptin release.
